"ASTM A307, 1/4-1 1/2 in" = "A307 itself covers 1/4-4 in and specifies no proof or yield (Shigley's values); grade B is 60-100 ksi, for flanged joints with cast iron flanges. Source: Budynas & Nisbett, Shigley's Mechanical Engineering Design, 10th ed., Table 8-10; Portland Bolt specification summary ASTM A307; Portland Bolt, fastener identification markings"
"ASTM A325, 1/2-1 in" = "Withdrawn 2016: now F3125 grade A325. Source: Budynas & Nisbett, Shigley's Mechanical Engineering Design, 10th ed., Table 8-10; Portland Bolt specification summary ASTM A325"

"ASTM F3125 grade A325, 1/2-1 1/2 in" = "Heavy hex structural bolt; = AASHTO M164. Twist-off version: grade F1852. Source: Portland Bolt specification summary ASTM F3125; Portland Bolt, fastener identification markings"
"ASTM F3125 grade 144, 1/2-1 1/2 in" = "Heavy hex or twist-off. Source: Portland Bolt specification summary ASTM F3125"
"ASTM F3125 grade A490, 1/2-1 1/2 in" = "Not hot-dip galvanized or zinc electroplated (hydrogen embrittlement); F3393 Zn/Al coating permitted. = AASHTO M253. Twist-off version: grade F2280. Source: Portland Bolt specification summary ASTM F3125; Portland Bolt, fastener identification markings"
"ASTM A354 grade BC, 1/4-2 1/2 in" = "Source: Budynas & Nisbett, Shigley's Mechanical Engineering Design, 10th ed., Table 8-10; Portland Bolt specification summary ASTM A354"
"ASTM A354 grade BC, 2 3/4-4 in" = "Source: Budynas & Nisbett, Shigley's Mechanical Engineering Design, 10th ed., Table 8-10; Portland Bolt specification summary ASTM A354"
"ASTM A354 grade BD, 1/4-4 in" = "Over 2 1/4 in: more alloy and Charpy 20 ft-lbf at -4 °F. Source: Budynas & Nisbett, Shigley's Mechanical Engineering Design, 10th ed., Table 8-10; Portland Bolt specification summary ASTM A354"
"ASTM A449, 1/4-1 in" = "Any configuration: headed bolts, rods, anchor bolts. Source: Budynas & Nisbett, Shigley's Mechanical Engineering Design, 10th ed., Table 8-10; Portland Bolt specification summary ASTM A449; Portland Bolt, fastener identification markings"
"ASTM A449, 1 1/8-1 1/2 in" = "Source: Budynas & Nisbett, Shigley's Mechanical Engineering Design, 10th ed., Table 8-10; Portland Bolt specification summary ASTM A449; Portland Bolt, fastener identification markings"
"ASTM A449, 1 3/4-3 in" = "Portland Bolt gives this range as 1 5/8-3 in. Source: Budynas & Nisbett, Shigley's Mechanical Engineering Design, 10th ed., Table 8-10; Portland Bolt specification summary ASTM A449; Portland Bolt, fastener identification markings"
"ASTM A490, 1/2-1 1/2 in" = "Withdrawn 2016: now F3125 grade A490. Source: Budynas & Nisbett, Shigley's Mechanical Engineering Design, 10th ed., Table 8-10; Portland Bolt specification summary ASTM A490; Portland Bolt, fastener identification markings"
"ASTM F1554 grade 36, 1/2-4 in" = "Anchor bolts; = AASHTO M314 grade 36. A weldable grade 55 may be supplied instead. Source: Portland Bolt specification summary ASTM F1554; Portland Bolt, fastener identification markings"
